bio: Ferrante Maletta, also recorded as Ferdinando, was born in 1668 at San Mango di Aquino in Calabria and was John's 10th-great-grandfather. His marriage to Isabella Moraco is recorded on 5 June 1695, though their daughter Anna Maria is said to have been born in 1692, so the records disagree on the order of events. Another daughter, Francesca Giovanna, died as a child in December 1702. Ferrante died some time between 1719 and 1747.
